## Goal

Upload the image fills used by the design to the Webflow asset library. 46 images are indexed in `figma/assets.json`, 46 without a Webflow URL. Brand SVGs (9) and vectors (61) are committed under `figma/` and are uploaded only when a build needs them as image files.

## Steps

1. Check that assets/asset-manifest.json and assets/images/ exist (both gitignored; a fresh checkout needs the snapshot image fills, see `figma/README.md`).
2. List files over 4MB; resize each on the long edge only (aspect ratio kept), let Webflow handle AVIF compression.
3. Present the count, total size and resized files, and wait for a yes.
4. Run `pnpm run upload-assets` (dedup by MD5). Then run `pnpm figma:queue` so `figma/assets.json` picks up each `webflowUrl` and `webflowAssetId` from the manifest.
5. Run `pnpm run update-metadata --dry-run` to list assets missing alt text (alt text generation is paid; it needs a separate yes).
